title: The tech backlash is now in theaters
hook_text: Aaron Sorkin just targeted Mark Zuckerberg.
script:
Aaron Sorkin directs The Social Reckoning to frame Mark Zuckerberg as a robotic villain.
Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim released You Can See Everything to critique Silicon Valley.
These 2026 features take a much more critical look at how disruptive tech founders reshape reality.
Hollywood films once romanticized startup culture before shifting toward this severe cultural pushback.
Audiences now see stories where tech ambitions are blamed for destabilizing modern society.
Would you watch a movie about tech founders breaking society?
